caseName: N.Y.S. Rifle & Pistol Ass'n, Inc. v. City of N.Y.
caseNameFull: NEW YORK STATE RIFLE & PISTOL ASSOCIATION, INC. v. CITY OF NEW YORK, NEW YORK

opinions.text: The Respondent' Suggestion of Mootness denied. The question of mootness will be subject to further consideration at oral argument, and the parties should be prepared to discuss it.
